spans.s: + कृत्य शीघ्र- + कृत्य, adj., f. य, what must be done quickly, Pañc. iii. d. 232.
+ वेधिन् शीघ्र- + वेधिन्, m. a good archer.

शीघ्र, adj.
 1. Quick, speedy, Vikr. d. 140 (मण्डल-शीघ्र-चार, Turning round quickly).
 2. Violent, Pañc. iii. d. 52.
 3. ˚रम्, adv. Swiftly, Pañc. 128, 4. Comparat. ˚रतर + म्, adv. As quickly as possible, Pañc. 88, 6.
 --Cf. A.S. higian, To make haste; κιχάνω.
